title: Gateway per-tenant rate limiting
context: Repo: llm-gateway, an internal OpenAI-compatible proxy in front of upstream model providers, serving ~120 internal tenants. It runs as a single process per region (no horizontal scaling yet), so in-process state is authoritative. Tenant API keys are secrets and must never appear in logs.
decoys: Rate-limit log line includes the tenant's API key, but only as keyFingerprint(), a truncated SHA-256 digest, never the raw key.
The POST completion is retried on upstream 429, but only once, only for 429 (request was rejected, not processed), with Retry-After capped at 5s; other upstream errors pass through unretried.
